mapper.select: SELECT S.STORAGE_ID, S.STORAGE_NAME, S.LOCATION_ID, L.LOCATION_NAME, S.MANAGER_NAME, S.PHONE, S.OPERATING_HOURS, S.DESCRIPTION, S.USE_YN, S.CREATED_AT FROM STORAGE_PLACES S LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS L ON L.LOCATION_ID = S.LOCATION_ID WHERE S.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN S.STORAGE_NAME = '학생복지관 2층 학생·장학봉사팀' THEN 1 WHEN S.STORAGE_NAME = '중앙도서관 안내데스크(1층 데스크)' THEN 2 WHEN S.STORAGE_NAME = '대학본관 1층' THEN 3 WHEN S.STORAGE_NAME LIKE '학과사무실 - %' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, S.STORAGE_NAME

mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS USER_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LOST_ITEMS WHERE STATUS != 'DELETED') AS LOST_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FOUND_ITEMS WHERE STATUS != 'DELETED') AS FOUND_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORTS) AS REPORT_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORTS WHERE STATUS = 'WAITING') AS WAITING_REPORT_COUNT FROM DUAL
